These operations mirror mathematical duality between inference (learning), forecasting (modeling), and control (optimization). Each primitive operates under distinct regimes—algorithmic selection under uncertainty, model execution under stability, and optimization under feasibility. Failure modes arise from misalignment between data regime and operational assumptions. The system exhibits robustness through feedback loops in plan adjustment and adaptive data collection. Dualities emerge in how each primitive maps to Bayesian updating, predictive density estimation, and constrained extremum seeking respectively.
